prompt:
Hi, I need you to set up the automated code review system for our payment-service project. The team has a PR on branch `feature/payment-v2` in the repository at `/workspace/payment-service` that needs a thorough security and quality review before we merge to production.

Specifically, I'd like you to:

1. Configure the code review automation system so that it automatically fixes issues and automatically continues to the next review round without asking me every time. Set the maximum rounds to 5, and configure it to fix all issues including medium severity ones. Save this configuration in the standard location used by the review tool.

2. Do a pre-flight assessment of this PR — figure out how many files were changed and added, determine the right timeout settings for this size of change, and save the results to a file called `preflight_assessment.json` in the `/workspace` directory.

3. Conduct a full code review of the PR changes (comparing `feature/payment-v2` to `origin/develop`) using the parallel multi-reviewer approach, classify every issue you find with the proper severity levels, and save everything to a file called `review_report.json` in the `/workspace` directory. Make sure your report includes the exit criteria status and notes what would need to happen for the final validation round.
